title: Konami's own console game series by total cumulative sales: METAL GEAR leads at 67.7M (as of the end of September 2026)
game: METAL GEAR, Yu-Gi-Oh!, PAWAFURU PUROYAKYU, Momotaro Dentetsu, SILENT HILL (series); eFootball as the closing line
why: Evergreen bank piece (numbers). DATES IT: Konami updates the page with its quarterly results (next: Q3 FY2027, early Feb 2027).

sources.name: Konami Group, Digital Entertainment Business page, Console Game table 'Total Cumulative Sales (million)', each '(Note) as of the end of September 2026'

first_report: Konami's own Digital Entertainment page, figures as of the end of September 2026, read 8 Nov 2026 about 18:25Z through the normal fetch tool and a plain request with an honest client name. Evergreen.
footage: Our graphics (numbers): the product images from Konami's own page for the five series, ending on two official eFootball Steam screenshots (1920x1080). No single footage covers five series; sources tried first: none better for this list (Square Enix, Sega Sammy and Koei Tecmo gave scattered figures, see the final report).

claims.text: Console Game, Total Cumulative Sales (million), (Note) as of the end of September 2026: METAL GEAR series 67.7; Yu-Gi-Oh! series 32.7; PAWAFURU PUROYAKYU series 26.9; Momotaro Dentetsu series 20.2; SILENT HILL series 19.2

Footnote: '*Includes units shipped, store downloads and subscription services', marked after the SILENT HILL figure; the page does not say whether it applies to that row only or to the whole console table, so the Reel says it of SILENT HILL only
Console & Mobile Game table: eFootball series 1,000 million 'Total Cumulative Sales & Total Cumulative Downloads', as of April 2026 (a different table and date; used only as the closing line)

The table is Konami's list of its console series, not a ranking of every Konami title; the mobile table (Professional Baseball Spirits A 76 million downloads, Jikkyou Pawafuru Puroyakyu 54 million) is not in it

gate: gate 18:35Z: Konami page read in full (WebFetch and plain fetch, honest client name, no workaround); as-of dates and footnote recorded. Exit A.
